<div id="auth-panel">
  <h2>Anmeldung</h2>
  <p id="auth-message">Melde dich an, um deine Aufgaben zu laden.</p>
  <label for="email">E-Mail</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" autocomplete="username"
         placeholder="E-Mail-Adresse" />
  <label for="password">Passwort</label>
  <input id="password" type="password"
         autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Passwort" />
  <div class="auth-buttons">
    <button id="login">Anmelden</button>
    <button id="register">Konto erstellen</button>
  </div>
  <button id="reset-password">Passwort zurücksetzen</button>
</div>

<div id="app-panel" hidden>
  <p>Angemeldet: <span id="user-email"></span></p>
  <button id="logout">Abmelden</button>
  <p id="sync-status">Lade Aufgaben …</p>
</div>

<div id="todo-content" hidden>

<style>
#auth-panel {
  max-width: 420px;
  margin: 2rem auto;
  padding: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 10px;
}
#auth-panel label,
#auth-panel input {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0.4rem 0;
}
#auth-panel input {
  padding: 0.65rem;
}
.auth-buttons {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
}
#todo-content li input[type="date"] {
  margin-left: 12px;
  font: inherit;
}
#todo-content li input[type="checkbox"] {
  margin-right: 6px;
}
#sync-status {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}
</style>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", async () => {
  const SUPABASE_URL = "https://ixrpqqexnsuhiaafamki.supabase.co";
  const SUPABASE_KEY = "sb_publishable_c4HSOzjc5uD7noHzGLPMMg_RFUfIc66";

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const client = window.supabase.createClient(
    SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY
  );

  let currentUser = null;
  let tasks = [];
  let saveQueue = Promise.resolve();

  const setMessage = (message) => {
    $("auth-message").textContent = message;
  };

  const setStatus = (message) => {
    $("sync-status").textContent = message;
  };

  function getTaskText(item, checkbox) {
    const clone = item.cloneNode(true);
    clone.querySelectorAll(
      'input, button, script, style'
    ).forEach(el => el.remove());

    return clone.textContent.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  }

  function getTaskKey(index, title) {
    return `${index}:${title}`;
  }

  function collectTasks() {
    const checkboxes = [
      ...document.querySelectorAll(
        "#todo-content li input[type=checkbox]"
      )
    ];

    return checkboxes.map((checkbox, index) => {
      const item = checkbox.closest("li");
      let dateInput = item.querySelector('input[type="date"]');

      if (!dateInput) {
        dateInput = document.createElement("input");
        dateInput.type = "date";
        dateInput.setAttribute("aria-label", "Fälligkeitsdatum");
        item.appendChild(dateInput);
      }

      const title = getTaskText(item, checkbox);
      const key = getTaskKey(index, title);

      return {
        item, checkbox, dateInput,
        title, key, sortOrder: index
      };
    });
  }

  async function loadTasks() {
    const { data, error } = await client
      .from("todo_tasks")
      .select("task_key,title,completed,due_date,sort_order")
      .eq("user_id", currentUser.id);

    if (error) throw error;

    const saved = new Map(data.map(row => [row.task_key, row]));

    // Neue Aufgaben ergänzen, ohne gespeicherte Werte zu überschreiben.
    const missing = tasks.filter(task => !saved.has(task.key));

    if (missing.length) {
      const rows = missing.map(task => ({
        user_id: currentUser.id,
        task_key: task.key,
        title: task.title,
        completed: task.checkbox.checked,
        due_date: task.dateInput.value || null,
        sort_order: task.sortOrder
      }));

      const { error: insertError } = await client
        .from("todo_tasks")
        .upsert(rows, { onConflict: "user_id,task_key" });

      if (insertError) throw insertError;

      return loadTasks();
    }

    tasks.forEach(task => {
      const row = saved.get(task.key);
      if (!row) return;

      task.checkbox.checked = row.completed;
      task.dateInput.value = row.due_date || "";
    });

    sortTasks();
  }

  function sortTasks() {
    const groups = new Map();

    tasks.forEach(task => {
      const parent = task.item.parentElement;
      if (!groups.has(parent)) groups.set(parent, []);
      groups.get(parent).push(task);
    });

    groups.forEach((items, parent) => {
      items.sort((a, b) => {
        const da = a.dateInput.value;
        const db = b.dateInput.value;
        if (!da && !db) return a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder;
        if (!da) return 1;
        if (!db) return -1;
        return da.localeCompare(db) || a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder;
      });

      items.forEach(task => parent.appendChild(task.item));
    });
  }

  function saveTasks() {
    if (!currentUser) return;

    // Warteschlange verhindert, dass schnelle Änderungen
    // sich beim Speichern gegenseitig überholen.
    saveQueue = saveQueue.then(async () => {
      setStatus("Synchronisiere …");

      const rows = tasks.map(task => ({
        user_id: currentUser.id,
        task_key: task.key,
        title: task.title,
        completed: task.checkbox.checked,
        due_date: task.dateInput.value || null,
        sort_order: task.sortOrder,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }));

      const { error } = await client
        .from("todo_tasks")
        .upsert(rows, { onConflict: "user_id,task_key" });

      if (error) throw error;
      setStatus("Synchronisiert");
    }).catch(error => {
      console.error(error);
      setStatus("Speichern fehlgeschlagen: " + error.message);
    });

    return saveQueue;
  }

  function showApp(user) {
    currentUser = user;
    $("auth-panel").hidden = true;
    $("app-panel").hidden = false;
    $("todo-content").hidden = false;
    $("user-email").textContent = user.email || "";
  }

  async function openApp(user) {
    showApp(user);
    tasks = collectTasks();

    try {
      setStatus("Lade Aufgaben …");
      await loadTasks();

      tasks.forEach(task => {
        task.checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
          saveTasks();
        });

        task.dateInput.addEventListener("change", async () => {
          sortTasks();
          await saveTasks();
        });
      });

      setStatus("Synchronisiert");
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      setStatus("Fehler beim Laden: " + error.message);
    }
  }

  $("login").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const { data, error } = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: $("email").value.trim(),
      password: $("password").value
    });

    if (error) return setMessage(error.message);
    await openApp(data.user);
  });

  $("register").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const { data, error } = await client.auth.signUp({
      email: $("email").value.trim(),
      password: $("password").value
    });

    if (error) return setMessage(error.message);

    if (!data.session) {
      setMessage("Prüfe deine E-Mails und bestätige deine Registrierung.");
    } else {
      await openApp(data.user);
    }
  });

  $("reset-password").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const email = $("email").value.trim();
    if (!email) return setMessage("Gib zuerst deine E-Mail-Adresse ein.");

    const { error } = await client.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email);
    setMessage(error ? error.message : "Falls ein Konto existiert, erhältst du eine E-Mail.");
  });

  $("logout").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const { error } = await client.auth.signOut();
    if (error) return setStatus(error.message);

    currentUser = null;
    tasks = [];
    $("app-panel").hidden = true;
    $("todo-content").hidden = true;
    $("auth-panel").hidden = false;
    setMessage("Du wurdest abgemeldet.");
  });

  const { data, error } = await client.auth.getSession();

  if (error) {
    setMessage(error.message);
    return;
  }

  if (data.session) {
    await openApp(data.session.user);
  }
});
</script>
